action_limits.bounds_source: Boxes from pinned RoboDojo ee67a14: arm bases env_cfg/robot/dual_x5.yml (left [-0.3,-0.45,0.765], right [0.3,-0.45,0.765]); reach 0.912 m = sum of X5A.urdf joint-origin offsets base_link->link6->finger joints (all-links-straight upper bound); z from 5 cm below the table top (env_cfg/scene/default.yml: table z 0.74 + 0.025) to base + reach. review_source: OEH review mode (runtime/oeh_policy/review.py, teacher.py; prompts in runtime/oeh_policy/teacher/): gpt-6-astra at reasoning effort xhigh reviews every OpenWAM-Alpha chunk from the three camera views, the end-effector state and the proposal, and answers with one robodojo_execute call (accept the chunk, a bounded correction, hold, or home); the OEH gateway admits and executes the decision. The reference configuration R0 of the OEH study (docs/agent-icl-study: review template openwam-review.template.json with the campaign matrix's decision_seconds 60 and wall_seconds 21600). The study ran the same model through the Codex app-server (ChatGPT login); this submission calls the OpenAI Responses API with a key read from api_key_file (NAME=value or a bare key, never in a configuration).
